data.description:

data.title: DarkIris Calls October 2026 EGM to Tighten Share Structure and Expand Supervoting Rights
data.description:
An update from DarkIris Inc. Class A ( (DKI) ) is now available.

DarkIris Inc. announced on September 18, 2026, that it will convene an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders in Xiamen, China, on October 6, 2026 local time (October 5 Eastern) to vote on significant changes to its capital structure and governing documents. Shareholders of record as of September 15, 2026 are eligible to participate, with the board unanimously backing all proposed resolutions.

The Scheduled Termination Date for these waivers, initially set under a June 25, 2026 amendment and subsequently extended on September 4, 10, and 18, 2026, now runs through September 24, 2026 and includes temporary relief from minimum liquidity and collateral coverage requirements.

The company is concurrently conducting an evaluation of strategic alternatives through a board-appointed special committee, considering options such as financing, recapitalization, restructuring, and potential M&A transactions.
